correctness.rationale: The four explicit translations map the long corridor through exactly 4n exterior indices: the nonzero index permutation is j->j+(2n-1) mod 4n and gcd(2n-1,4n)=1. The short corridor returns after 2 steps. Total tower lengths 2L+(4n+1)eta fill the original interval, so no omitted excursion. The induced rotation has wrap count floor((x+kL)/(L+eta)); consequently the long count is k minus that wrap count and t_k=2k+(4n-1)H_k, giving a bounded coboundary. A direct independently implemented exact-Fraction four-piece IET verified the return and roof across 1200 representative base states, n=1..4; the unrestricted proof is the permutation arithmetic. Uniform x has two possible wrap counts, giving the advertised mean/variance; rational u/v rotation has u+v returns with v long and u short excursions, so least original period exactly 2u+(4n+1)v. The original half-open map handles endpoints; geometric statement excludes ambiguous planar branch endpoints.
